events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic second solo album, 'Imagine', was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago today, John Lennon released an album that gave the world an anthem for peace. Still as relevant as ever.

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Gordon Sumner, known worldwide as Sting, the legendary musician from The Police and a successful solo artist, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Sting
angles.copy: From fronting The Police to a stellar solo career, Sting turns 75 today! What's your favourite track from the Geordie legend?

events.title: First Apple iPod released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how the world consumed music.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple dropped a game-changer that put a thousand songs in your pocket.

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in London in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Today is Global James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) to 007 and his six decades of thrilling adventures.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks the birthday of The Beatles co-founder and music icon, John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent and enduring legacy of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! What's your favourite moment from the comedy legend?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles delivered their sprawling, experimental masterpiece: the 'White Album'. Still sounds incredible.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost him, but Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. Remembering a true legend today.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' album was released sixty-one years ago today.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Remembered
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost a visionary. Remembering the life and music of John Lennon.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The visionary artist David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's 80th
angles.copy: On what would have been his 80th birthday, we celebrate the extraordinary life and boundless creativity of David Bowie. Forever missed.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Elvis
angles.copy: Ninety-two years ago today, a legend was born. Remembering Elvis Presley, the King of Rock & Roll.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Jimmy Page
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the iconic guitar hero, Jimmy Page! What's your favourite Led Zeppelin riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The distinctive voice of Sir Rod Stewart, one of the best-selling music artists of all time, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rod Stewart
angles.copy: Happy 82nd Birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! What's your go-to track from his incredible career?
